prices._units: token base units, 8 decimals. Allowance prices are per 1,000 Mana/day for the whole term ($0.03 / $0.20 / $0.75); big upload $0.05 per 1,000 Mana, minimum 5,000 Mana = 25,000,000 ($0.25). Price = ceil(whole Mana × tier / 1,000)

prices._rules: durations only 1, 7, 30 days (others refused). Price changes apply to new purchases and renewals only; each allowance/ticket stores token, tier price and amount paid. Renewal is charged at the price current at renewal time. No auto-renew: renew needs the payer's own signature
prices._min_purchase: 0 = no minimum (Carl, Oct 19 8:43 PM: no default minimum). The owner can still set one per token. Slot squatting is limited by the target-app signature, max_per_buyer and max_allowances instead; see engineering.md for the residual risk

_big_upload_limits.status: DECIDED by Carl (7:32 PM): approved as proposed; all owner-adjustable via set_config
_big_upload_limits.big_max: 6,000 Mana per request (must be >= the 5,000 minimum)
_big_upload_limits.scaling: debt is repaid at the sellable slice's rate: 6,000 takes 6,000 / sellable days (e.g. 40k KOIN → 2,000/day → 3 days). Suggested rule: big_max_debt ≈ 3 × sellable/day, week cap ≈ 2 × big_max; re-set when koin_amount changes
_big_upload_limits.at_30k: unavailable: sellable slice is 0 (quote reason 'no repayment capacity')
_big_upload_limits.big_ticket_ms: 24 h (DECIDED 8:02 PM; 0 also means 24 h); owner-adjustable
_big_upload_limits.big_cooldown_ms: 24 h between purchases PER BUYER, counted from the purchase (audit #2: was station-wide, which let one buyer block everyone)

_buffer.rule: fee-exempt reserved apps may use up to 20% above their daily allowance (3,000 → 3,600). The extra comes straight from the reserve: no debt, no repayment, no cut to the next day. Paid allowances stay hard-capped at what was bought (buy more to get more)
_buffer.hard_floor: 6,100 Mana (admin_min 100 + daily budget 6,000) is never used by the buffer
_buffer.worst_day: 3,600 + 3,600 = 7,200 vs 6,000 refill → the reserve dips by at most 1,200 that day
_buffer.alerts: station.buffer_used on each buffer tx; station.reserve_low once per dip below alert_mana (15,000) → add KOIN
_buffer.no_reservation_projects: exempt projects with app 0 still use only the unsold sellable slice (0 at 30k)

_terms.status: DRAFT rewritten 2026-10-19 (audit #1/#6 + Carl 8:19 PM ticket model) to promise only what the code does; legal review pending
_terms.allowance: DRAFT, pending legal review. Prepaid Mana for one app contract. The station sponsors a transaction only when every top-level operation in it calls that app; what the app does internally when called is up to the app. The app's own key must approve the purchase. Per-user anti-spam limits apply to each of the app's users. Each wallet may hold a limited number of open allowances and tickets at once. Payment is held at the station's address until the term ends, then released to the operator. Until the station's planned permission upgrade, that address is controlled by the operator's key: this is operator custody, not trustless escrow. If the operator sets a minimum charge, it is shown in the quote and kept if you cancel. Cancel any time: unused whole days are refunded (the current day counts as used, so 1 day is the minimum charge). If the operator pauses the station, paused time is credited: your term is extended by the pause. No auto-renew: service stops at expiry unless you renew, at the price current then. 1-, 7- and 30-day terms only. Non-transferable; not redeemable for crypto or cash except these refunds. Introductory prices may increase for new purchases. A buyer may be suspended for abuse, sanctions or AUP reasons; suspended time is not extended, and the operator may refund unused days (never to a sanctioned party).
_terms.big_upload: DRAFT, pending legal review. Prepaid big upload: the station reserves the Mana you buy for you for one full 24-hour period, at the full price, whether you use it or not. Reserved Mana is not sold again or spent by the station's other services. Paid in vUSDT or vUSDC and held at the station's address (operator custody until the planned permission upgrade, not trustless escrow). If the lock runs its full period, nothing is refunded. If you end it early, you get back the value of the Mana you have not used, reduced in a straight line by the time already passed (for example, half the Mana left with three quarters of the time left returns 37.5% of the price), always keeping a fee (currently 5%). If the operator sets a minimum charge, it is shown in the quote and kept if you cancel. Refunds are only in the stablecoin you paid, never in Mana or KOIN. Each buyer can buy one ticket per cooldown period (default 24 hours). Tickets only sponsor uploading or calling the payee's own contract. In rare cases (for example if the station's Mana falls below its safety floor) a transaction can still be refused; tell the operator, who may refund the unexpired share. Paused time extends the lock. No auto-renew. Non-transferable; not redeemable for crypto or cash except these refunds. Each wallet may hold a limited number of open allowances and tickets at once. A buyer may be suspended for abuse, sanctions or AUP reasons; the operator may refund the unexpired share (never to a sanctioned party).
_terms.where: quote_allowance / quote_big_upload (terms, refundable=true, auto_renew=false) and every purchase_event

_suspend.methods: suspend_allowance(buyer, reason) / unsuspend_allowance(buyer, reason) / get_suspension(buyer); owner only
_suspend.effect: all allowances and big-upload tickets paid for by that buyer stop being sponsored; new buys/renewals by them refused; no money moves, no refund; suspended time is not extended or credited
_suspend.events: station.buyer_suspended / station.buyer_unsuspended (suspend_event: buyer, reason, suspended, at)

_escrow.payments: pulled into the station's own escrow (per purchase: token, amount, start, end, days, per-day rate)
_escrow.buyer_cancel: cancel_allowance: unused WHOLE days refunded; the current day counts as used (1-day minimum); service runs to the end of the paid day. Future renewed terms refunded in full
_escrow.ticket_fee: Carl, Oct 19 8:19 + 8:43 PM: a ticket locks its Mana for the full lock (24 h) at the full price, used or not. Early end refunds floor(floor(paid × time left / lock) × unused Mana / ticket Mana): the unused Mana's value, decayed by elapsed time (e.g. 50% left with 75% of the time left = 37.5%). Always keeps ticket_fee_bp (default 5%, max 20%, rounded up). Full lock or used-up Mana = no refund. owner_refund: same formula, no fee, lifts the buyer's wait
_escrow.tickets: SUPERSEDED 8:10 PM by ticket_fee. Was (7:59 PM): no minimum charge. cancel_big_upload or expiry (close_ticket, anyone): unused Mana refunded in full, exactly pro rata = floor(paid × unused Mana / ticket Mana) in base units (< 1 token unit in Carl's favour); earned part released at settlement
_escrow.release: release(purchase_id): anyone, only after the term ends, exactly once, to the treasury (owner wallet by default; the station itself is refused). No early release, no owner withdrawal of escrow
_escrow.rounding: refund = floor(amount × unused / total): rounds down by < 1 base unit (1e-8 token) in Carl's favour; refund + release always equals the amount paid
_escrow.pause: paused time is credited: the escrow clock stops while paused and every running/upcoming term, allowance and ticket is extended by the pause on unpause
_escrow.suspension: owner_refund refunds unused days/Mana (no minimum charge) for buyers not at fault (reason 4) or by owner choice for abuse/AUP; sanctions (reason 2): refund AND release frozen until legal review (reclassify a false match to reason 4)
_escrow.invariant: per token: station balance == held == collected − refunded − released
_escrow.ticket_anti_spam: Audit #2: one ticket per buyer per big_cooldown_ms (24 h) from purchase; no station-wide wait. Unused Mana is still released from the outstanding and weekly counters at settlement. Holding a ticket now costs its full price
_escrow.auto_close: Audit #4 + review M1: every buy_allowance / renew / buy_big_upload first closes up to 8 finished purchases IN THE SAME TOKEN (ended terms, expired or used-up tickets), so the open list (cap 128) can't fill up and one broken token can't block purchases in the other. Purchases of suspended payers or suspended allowance owners are skipped
_escrow.min_charge: Review M3: each purchase stores min_keep = min(min_purchase, paid). Buyer cancels never refund below it; owner refunds (buyer not at fault) ignore it
_escrow.ticket_lock: Review H1: big.ticket_open = unused Mana of open tickets. New tickets are sold only if Mana − request ≥ big floor + ticket_open; buffers and other tickets can't spend into it
_escrow.cancel_future_term: Review C1 (critical, pre-existing): cancelling refunds a renewed future term in full AND closes it; it no longer extends the service (previously ~86% back with the service kept)

_only_paying_apps: DECIDED by Carl (Oct 19, 9:09 PM): sponsorship only when every op calls ONE contract that is a fee-exempt Carl app (Knode/Stories) or holds an active paid app allowance (kind 1); Mana from that app's allowance. Account allowances (kind 2) removed. KOIN and stablecoin contracts can never be allowance targets. Mixed targets refused. Tickets: payee's own contract only.
